name: – Dariusz Joński – Draft Council decision
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the accession of the Kingdom of Tonga to the Interim Partnership Agreement between the European Community, of the one part, and the Pacific States, of the other part
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that Tonga should join a trade agreement between the European Union and Pacific countries. Tonga has become too wealthy to benefit from the EU's special lower-tariff scheme for developing countries. Joining this agreement gives Tonga another way to trade more easily with the EU and the region. The Parliament's consent is needed before the deal can go ahead. The report does not change the agreement itself; it approves Tonga joining it.

- Tonga joins the EU-Pacific trade agreement, giving it easier trade terms with the EU.
- Tonga and its exporters are affected, plus EU traders dealing with the region.
- The Council can now formally approve Tonga's accession.
